expectations.text: Declares the readers: support leads and backend engineers
expectations.evidence: Frontmatter audience: "Support leads, who handle the monthly usage-report requests..." and "Backend engineers who will build the feature"; body has a section per group.

expectations.text: States the problem with concrete evidence from the brief (212 requests in October, or the Lumen Logistics churn) before the detailed solution and its constraints
expectations.evidence: "Problem." paragraph cites "212 of these requests in October" and Lumen Logistics churn; it precedes the detailed support/engineering sections where delivery design and volume constraints are given (opening paragraph only summarizes the proposal).

expectations.text: States an objective or goal the solution is measured against
expectations.evidence: "Goal. A Business account admin sets up an export once, and the usage report reaches the recipients on schedule without a request to support."

expectations.text: Lists out of scope: PDF exports, custom column selection, and the Starter plan
expectations.evidence: "Out of scope." lists PDF exports, choosing columns, Starter-plan accounts.

expectations.text: Gives each reader group the content it needs: what changes for support and when, and the volume and delivery constraints for engineers
expectations.evidence: Support section: what changes (self-service, remaining requests) and when ("release date is not set yet; it follows the engineering estimate"). Engineer section: 2M+ rows/month, signed link delivery, frequency, recipients.

expectations.text: Explains that exports arrive as a signed link valid for 7 days and why: attachments fail for accounts with 2M+ rows
expectations.evidence: "Large accounts produce more than 2 million usage rows per month, so a monthly export ... cannot travel as an email attachment. Each run therefore stores the CSV and emails a signed download link to it, valid for 7 days."

expectations.text: The proposal itself appears within the first few paragraphs, before supporting detail
expectations.evidence: First paragraph: "Account admins on the Business plan will schedule a CSV export ... The proposed delivery is a signed download link valid for 7 days".
